prompts.prompt: Use case: style-transfer / precise-object-edit. Create a photoreal aerial orthophoto art revision of INPUT IMAGE 1 (the Veles detailed map with many repetitive pasted roofs). INPUT IMAGE 2 is STYLE ONLY: the approved Veles natural realistic aerial map. Preserve IMAGE 1's exact camera, field of view, frame, all river banks and stream course, road junctions and centerlines, bridges, quay, building footprint positions/orientations/count, and all Korean UI and location labels. Do NOT copy the geography of image 2. Replace the visibly pasted sprite artwork in image 1 with one coherent real photographic landscape matching image 2: individually weathered, different gray/brown slate/wood roofs with subtle repair patches and moss, naturally integrated yards with uneven grass, foot-worn ground, vegetable beds and sparse low scrub within existing parcels. Make roads real unpaved paths with wheel tracks, varied gravel and natural soft grass edges while preserving their exact footprint and access. Irregular mixed broadleaf canopy structure, crowns overlapping naturally, interlocking green masses and small clearings, varied tree ages and subtle restrained olive tones, real shadows consistent with soft daylight. Continuous photographic ground, exposed natural gray stones and organic riverbank stones, dark teal believable moving water. NO repeated stamp patterns, uniformly isolated trees, rectangular brown yard pads, toy miniatures, isometric perspective, visible building facades, tree trunks or fantasy JRPG embellishments. Strict camera vertically straight down. Do not enlarge houses or move anything to fit. Preserve image 1 geometry and all four map edges. Maintain thin dark charcoal UI exactly. Natural integrated realism is the priority. Output the edited image at maximum practical native detail, landscape same aspect as input1.

Use case: style-transfer, geometry-locked aerial terrain surface. Edit INPUT IMAGE 1, a portrait 2:3 assembled Veles map of a 4096m by 6144m region. INPUT IMAGE 2 is approved PHOTO STYLE ONLY. KEEP INPUT1 EXACT GEOGRAPHY AND FRAMING: the small settlement at about x45%, y55%, all roads and forest trail network, the two angular river bends below town, main river exits at right near y8.3% and left near y91.7%, every road edge crossing, fields and village footprint. DO NOT change river layout to input2, do not enlarge village, do not add mountains, lakes, settlements or new roads. Make this ONE coherent high-detail true vertical orthographic aerial photograph in subdued olive/gray/brown and dark teal, not a game sprite map. Replace repeated tree stamps with a genuinely continuous natural mixed deciduous/conifer forest: overlapping crowns of varied species/ages/shapes/heights, canopy mosaics, irregular but subtle clearings and scrub, soil and exposed gray stone around existing shallow ridges. Vary existing cottage roofs and land use naturally at their EXACT placements; realistic organic fields and yards. Maintain existing road centerlines/junctions, wear edges subtly, realistic stream and river rocks. NO regular repeating pattern, isolated circular tree stamps, uniform tree grid, tiling texture, artificial yard rectangles, toy town or painterly/JRPG style. Soft neutral daylight consistent across entire region, strict nadir no horizon or visible facades. Preserve outermost 3 percent frame pixel-exact to input1 for neighboring seam compatibility, smoothly transition the natural surface inward with no band. No UI, no labels, no text, no grid. Highest practical native resolution, same portrait 2:3 as input1.

Edit target IMAGE1 is the exact georeferenced layout of the WHOLE Veles village, farms and river bend. IMAGE2 is approved photographic STYLE reference ONLY. IMAGE3 is a successful closer style study of the SAME village. Make IMAGE1 naturally photographic like image3 and image2, WITHOUT MOVING OR RESIZING a single building, bridge, quay, field boundary, street centerline, stream, river bank or road crossing at the image edge. All 86 roofs must retain their exact image1 footprint, orientation and count. Preserve full image1 framing at identical landscape aspect 11:7, no cropping. TRUE nadir aerial orthophoto, realistic muted olive forest canopy, weathered gray/brown stone/timber roofs, individual roofs differentiated with subtle moss, lichen, repair patches. Make yards individual lived-in land-use plots with worn ground, irregular low vegetation, tiny vegetable patches but no new buildings. All paths have realistic dirt and gravel, grass encroachment outside their preserved usable width. Overlapping varied native tree crowns in organic clusters, understory, variable canopy gaps, gray rocks on shallow ridges and natural rocky riverbanks. A single coherent photograph, not repeated sprites. No toy miniature, no isometric buildings, no elevated angled camera. Do not replace low relief with big mountains. No UI, names, symbols or writing. Maintain exact geometry and registration of image1. Highest available native detail, do not enlarge any village feature for readability.

Use case: geometry-preserving photographic style transfer. IMAGE1 is the edit target, a square strictly vertical orthographic forest/cave approach map; IMAGE2 is the required natural aerial photograph style reference ONLY. Repaint image1 as one coherent realistic aerial photograph matching the reference's mature olive mixed forest, gray rocks and subdued natural light. Eliminate repeated identical isolated tree sprites: use irregular interlocking overlapping 8-18m tree crowns, varied heights, species, patches of understory and small natural gaps; the world footprint is 1200 x 1200 meters, do NOT enlarge trees to giant 50-meter crowns. Preserve EXACT IMAGE1 coordinates and shapes: all narrow path centerlines, every angular path junction and boundary crossing, stream course and bridge placements, riverbank on the lower right, rocky shallow ridge and cave point at x71.7%,y25%. Cave is a small overhead dark rocky cleft, not a front-facing arch or giant hole. No new mountains, trails, buildings, river branches or world features. Natural dirt/gravel path surfaces and soft uneven verges, realistic forest ground. No repeating pattern, no toy diorama, no isometric angle, no visible tree trunks, no UI/text/symbols. Preserve full square framing, orientation and scale. High native detail. Do not shift the geometry while making surfaces natural.

note: Generated surface art is reviewed against unchanged geometry. Image edits alone do not prove pixel-exact geometry; numeric master and external border locking are separate.
